title: She called every evening... 📞 #shorts
description:
Every evening, his mom called. And every evening, he was too busy to pick up.

Then a little photo on his desk reminded him: when he was small, she was never too busy for him.

Call them back. They're still waiting. ❤️

Tag someone you need to call today.
